title: Dr. Guy Riekeman: Making Your Life Extraordinary
excerpt: Why We Interviewed Dr. Guy Riekeman Dr. Riekeman is a thought leader, a philosopher and an inspiring speaker who has had the opportunity to sit down and speak with some…
html:
Why We Interviewed Dr. Guy Riekeman

Dr. Riekeman is a thought leader, a philosopher and an inspiring speaker who has had the opportunity to sit down and speak with some of the greatest leaders in the World. In this fascinating and moving talk, he discusses how people can create an extraordinary life and shares insights on his experience sitting down for a private audience with the Daly Lama.

About Dr. Guy Riekeman

Dr. Guy Riekeman is the past President of Palmer University in Davenport, Iowa and Life University.

He is currently Life University Chancellor. Dr. Riekeman is a pioneer in the field of Health and Wellness and started a patient education program using video tapes back in 1977, when it was way ahead of its time.

title: Dr. Allison Patton: Helping Her Community Be Healthy
excerpt: Dr. Allison Patton is a naturopathic doctor business owner who is also a local politician and has energy, passion to fuel it all. Listen to her story.
html:
Why We Interviewed Dr. Allison Patton

We often talk about the fact that our business is also an extension of who we are. In today’s world, where information is so readily available, people are attracted to authentic businesses. Business owners who are passionate about what they do, act as a magnet.

At BizWell, we are celebrating businesses that incorporate wellness in their business.

About Dr. Allison Patton

Dr. Allison Patton is a Naturopathic Physician with 20 years experience. She is also a politician and mom of a Lacrosse world-class athlete. Dr. Patton is the perfect example of how, by infusing our personality in her business and being so passionate about serving others, she has been able to re-invent her business and navigate the storms.

title: Max Justus: Creating a Sustainable Shoe Company
excerpt: Max Justus is a Vancouver-based entrepreneur who is always looking at innovation and thinking outside the box to make a positive impact on people’s lives and the planet.
html:
Why We Interviewed Max Justus

We met Max Justus and Planted Expo in Vancouver and were very impressed by his business philosophy. His company, Grounded People is about being part of a movement, preserving the planet with sustainability. They operate from compassion-guided principles and their entire production process is cruelty-free.

The core principles of “grounded people” are based on the ethical treatment of all living beings. Taking sustainable actions to work with mother nature instead of against her.

About Max Justus

Max Justus is a Vancouver-based entrepreneur who is always looking at innovation and thinking outside the box to make a positive impact on people’s lives and the planet.

title: Gerald Auger: Story of Thriving Despite Early Childhood Trauma
excerpt: Gerald Auger is a First Nations actor, producer, writer, entrepreneur, and motivational speaker from Wabasca, Alberta. He is of Woodland Cree descent. In 1996 and 1997,…
html:
Gerald Auger is a First Nations actor, producer, writer, entrepreneur, and motivational speaker from Wabasca, Alberta. He is of Woodland Cree descent. In 1996 and 1997, Auger was awarded the National Native Role Model by the Governor-General of Canada and spent the next two years visiting more than thirteen communities across Canada, inspiring his aboriginal peers, relating stories about his experiences, and bonding with locals through cultural events and ceremonies.

In this interview, Gerald talks about why he interrupted his very successful career in Holywood to spend 6 years in the wilderness and discover what it means to be a 4 dimensional Human Being.

It was a real pleasure and honor for me to interview Gerald, who is scheduled to play a major part next to the french celebrity Michel Jonasz, in our upcoming film With An Open Heart
